note: КПК › Профілі: Profiles.json as raw text. Created by OZ_PdaVppPane.OnCreate and registered as the page pda.profiles of the module pda. Colours are the window's metal. КПК › Профілі (VPP rework 2026-11-12, design 5.3): the raw Profiles.json editor of the old PROFILES mini-tab, a page of its own until Ядро › Файли конфігів takes it over. Names the script reads: PdaProfEdit (and its Frame and Fill), PdaProfHint, BtnPdaProf*, PdaProfHead, PdaProfHeadRule, PdaProfFoot, PdaProfFootRule.

frame.name: PdaProfPane
frame.note: Hidden: ShowPane shows the open page and hides the rest. The shell moves the root into the content area and sizes it; 1060 x 680 is the content area of the default window.

frame.name: PdaProfRoot
frame.note: Proportional: follows the pane root when the shell resizes it.

frame.name: PdaProfHead
frame.note: The page head: title and one line on the left, the page's actions anchored right. OnWindowResized keeps it as wide as the page, so the actions follow the right edge.

button.name: BtnPdaProfOpen
button.note: Opens Ядро › Файли конфігів on Profiles.json, the page that takes this editor over (design 5.3).

field.name: PdaProfEdit
field.note: Profiles.json as text. 28 lines is what the 528-unit box holds at the 14-point field face; OnWindowResized gives the box the page's size.

button.name: BtnPdaProfApply
button.note: Asks on the window's confirm strip; off while the editor holds less than the whole file.
